panel.title: Orchestration
panel.description: The controller only assigns work, reads reports, and accepts results. Writing code, merging, running tests, and pushing all happen on your computer, through the local executor and the local AI.

panel.manageHint: Manage projects and executors in Settings → Orchestration

panel.allowShell: Allow the local AI to run test commands
panel.grantHint: Development and merge need the local AI to commit, so workspace write and git write are always granted. Integration branch: {{branch}}. Uncommitted changes in the main repository are not copied into the worktree. After you confirm, this round does not ask again step by step.

worktrees.title: Worktree management
worktrees.intro: This lists the worktrees each local executor created for orchestration. That executor lists and deletes them on its own machine; the server only sees what it reports. A confirmation card appears before anything is deleted. Worktrees with uncommitted changes, or ones an orchestration is still using, are not deleted.
